payload.title: Wedding Destinations in November for Autumn or Spring
payload.excerpt: For couples weighing wedding destinations, November comes down to a choice of hemisphere. North of the equator it is late autumn, and southern Europe is winding down its season. South of it, spring is turning to early summer.
key_takeaways: This list covers the Greek islands, Portugal, the Amalfi Coast, the French Riviera and Hawaii in the northern autumn, and New Zealand, Mauritius, the Seychelles, Fiji and Bali in the southern spring and early summer.
Europe is at the close of its season, so first settle whether your venue is open on the date and how the evening works as the air cools.
Fiji, Mauritius and the Seychelles begin their Smartraveller cyclone or monsoon seasons in November, and Bali and Hawaii are inside their wet windows, so book covered space and a buffer day.
Pick the November trade-off that suits your guests, whether that is a quieter European coast, a changeable New Zealand spring or a tropical island in its wet or cyclone season.

faq.q: Is November a good month for a destination wedding?
faq.a: Yes, if you accept its trade-off: a quieter, cooler Europe at the end of its season, spring in New Zealand, or warm islands in their wet or cyclone season.

faq.q: Where is warm for a wedding in November?
faq.a: The Indian Ocean islands. Mauritius records a November mean daily maximum of 30.2°C at Port Louis, and the Seychelles 30.3°C at Victoria. Both are entering their cyclone or monsoon season, so warmth comes with a rain plan.

faq.q: Is November cyclone season in Fiji and Mauritius?
faq.a: Yes. As at November 2026, Smartraveller puts it at November to April in Fiji and November to May in Mauritius. The Fiji Meteorological Service called November 2025 the start of the country's wet and cyclone season.

faq.q: Are European wedding venues open in November?
faq.a: It varies from venue to venue, so ask each one first and get the answer in writing, with which rooms are heated and whether the full team works on your date.

faq.q: Can Australians marry legally in these November destinations?
faq.a: Each country has its own requirements, and some couples marry legally at home and hold a symbolic ceremony abroad. Our legal and symbolic ceremony guides, above, explain the choice.
